headline: Sir Jim Ratcliffe chose to appoint rookies at Man United, and it has them facing relegation﻿ fight
description: Sir Jim Ratcliffe's naive backroom appointments have left Manchester United in their worst position for 40 years and staring relegation in the face.

headline: William Saliba injury comeback ramps up with Arsenal Under-21 outing
description: William Saliba stepped up his comeback by playing 45 minutes for Arsenal's Under-21s on Sunday.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Man United to hire USMNT's Pochettino to replace Carrick?
description: Manchester United are in the relegation zone and could turn to United States head coach Mauricio Pochettino to replace Michael Carrick. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Unai Emery storms off, explains exit as Man United equalised against Aston Villa
description: Unai Emery gave a frosty explanation of his premature exit from the sidelines after Aston Villa conceded a stoppage-time equaliser against Manchester United on Sunday

headline: Zirkzee, Dorgu score late to rescue a point for United
description: Manchester United net two late stoppage-time goals to draw with Aston Villa as Michael Carrick's job remains in the balance.

headline: Premier League VAR review: Should Man United's equalizing goal have been allowed?
description: VAR often causes controversy, but how are decisions made? Our resident ref, Andy Davies, explains all.
